Housing assistance

When a voucher or another program pays part of the rent. Each rent charge on an assisted lease gets the agency's share taken off the tenant's ledger by itself, and that share is owed by the agency here. Late fees, notices and autopay then use only the tenant's portion. If the agency doesn't pay, the tenant is not charged unless you move the amount to them.
